//: Type-checks the shipped registry items (registry/<item>/*.ts) against the workspace packages they import. Not a build — `noEmit`. Run via the root `lint:types:registry` script, which builds all packages first (`build:packages`) so every `@lunora/*` dist exists regardless of caller. `@lunora/*` maps to each package's built declarations (not src) so items are checked exactly as a consumer sees them, without recompiling package internals (which would pull Cloudflare-Workers globals from DO-backed packages). `bundler` resolution lets an item's `./schema.js` specifier resolve to its sibling `.ts`.
// exclude: Function templates that import the per-app builders (`mutation`/`query`/`action`/`internal*`) from `./_generated/server` — the path codegen emits in a real project — can't be checked here: that relative path only exists after codegen, and ambient declarations can't stub a relative specifier (same reason `crons/crons.ts`, which imports `./_generated/api`, is excluded). Items that import only published `@lunora/*` surfaces stay in and are checked against the mapped dist declarations above.
